# [Z8 — The attenuation budget is never partitioned](../hypodrafts/Z8.md "The attenuation budget is never partitioned")

*Generated by `scripts/pages/hypodraft_z8.py`: what the data held here can and cannot show about the hypothesis. Each marked statement links to what it rests on.*

**Draft, not a result.** <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-STATUS">The test this page specifies has not been run: no script in this repository computes it.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-STATUS "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## Where [Z8](../hypodrafts/Z8.md "The attenuation budget is never partitioned") overstates

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-HALF">[Z8](../hypodrafts/Z8.md "The attenuation budget is never partitioned") says Denmark measures broadband Kd, *which cannot be partitioned even in principle*. The first half is the protocol's own rule; the second holds for the number alone, but the missing partition is set **by protocol**, not by physics, and the archive holds, on the same casts, channels the protocol does not use.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-HALF "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-M06">The governing method document is DCE's technical instruction `M06` *Lyssvækkelse* by Markager and Fossing, version [3](../SOURCES.md#F-b326075d55), valid from [04.06.2015](../SOURCES.md#F-fc1fec41dc) ([PDF](https://ecos.au.dk/fileadmin/ecos/Fagdatacentre/Marin/TA_M06_Lyssvaekkelse_ver3.pdf)):</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-M06 "What this claim rests on")</sup>

- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-M06-PAR">One band, mandated: *skal der måles fotosyntetisk aktivt lys i intervallet* [400](../SOURCES.md#F-2bb77af308)–[700](../SOURCES.md#F-2bb77af308) *nm også kaldet PAR* — photosynthetically active light, one broad band.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-M06-PAR "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-M06-SPEC">Section `2.5.1` names the spectral mechanism and prescribes deletion as the cure: *Lysets spektrale sammensætning og spredning ændrer sig med vanddybden … en ikke-lineær hældning. I disse tilfælde kan det være nødvendigt at udelade lysmålinger fra den nederste del af vandsøjlen* — the light's spectrum changes with depth, the log-transformed profile can bend, and the lowest readings may then be left out.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-M06-SPEC "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-M06-BED">It also sets aside the readings nearest the bed where sediment is stirred up from the bottom (*Nederst i vandsøjlen kan sediment hvirvles op fra bunden*), and it leaves which readings to drop to the fitter's experience: *Der kan ikke gives præcise anvisninger til denne procedure*.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-M06-BED "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-WINDOW">Leaving out the lowest readings deletes the mineral signal a partition wants, and where a fit's profile starts matters: this project's light analysis finds the median depth at which light falls to [11](../SOURCES.md#F-e0cd5a53f8)% of the surface at [6.31](../SOURCES.md#F-b5f33a89f8) m in casts whose shallowest reading lies above [2](../SOURCES.md#F-5a6a77bc92) m, against [8.18](../SOURCES.md#F-301a45c3f7) m in those starting deeper.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-WINDOW "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-M06-FACTOR">Section `2.5.2`: in Danish waters the empirical constant converting Secchi depth to Kd varies between [1.5](../SOURCES.md#F-f8fc24617a) and [3.6](../SOURCES.md#F-f8fc24617a), but can be as low as [0.6](../SOURCES.md#F-ca98008f04) in very turbid systems where scattering matters, and up to [4.1](../SOURCES.md#F-4d1c493122) where dissolved matter dominates the attenuation; in practice it is set to [2.3](../SOURCES.md#F-2914daeb4b).</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-M06-FACTOR "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-RANGE">That range **is** the partition: the constant moves with what attenuates the light, so fixing it assumes the composition away.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-RANGE "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## The falsifiable consequence

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-PERCAST">Per **cast** — never a water body, which is why the area files `val_kd.bin` and `val_secchi.bin`, one value per coastal water body (`DKCOAST…`) and month, cannot serve here.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-PERCAST "What this claim rests on")</sup>

1. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-P-ORDER">**Ordering.** Ranking casts by the chlorophyll proxy does not reproduce the ranking by Kd, and casts above a Kd threshold fall into distinct composition types — high-FDOM/low-turbidity and high-turbidity/low-FDOM — rather than one.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-P-ORDER "What this claim rests on")</sup>
2. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-P-CONST">**The constant.** `Kd · z_Secchi` on the same station-day varies with FDOM and turbidity after station and month are removed. The instruction's own range predicts this; its fixed constant denies it.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-P-CONST "What this claim rests on")</sup>
3. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-P-ART">**The artefact.** The apparent-Kd decline with depth — in this project's light analysis the median ratio of lower-half to upper-half Kd is [0.879](../SOURCES.md#F-efdd02dc1e) for profiles starting between [0](../SOURCES.md#F-5e827a9f78) and [0.6](../SOURCES.md#F-8a6e7ba403) m, rising to [0.987](../SOURCES.md#F-976556d48d) for those starting below [5.1](../SOURCES.md#F-944f1be009) m — **weakens as FDOM rises**, because absorption by coloured dissolved organic matter at short wavelengths narrows the spread of K(λ) across the PAR band that produces the decline. The sign is the prediction; the magnitude needs an assumed K(λ) and is not part of the test.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-P-ART "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-EACHFAIL">Each can fail: the ordering would leave [Z8](../hypodrafts/Z8.md "The attenuation budget is never partitioned")'s attribution complaint empty here, the constant would make the fixed constant harmless, and the artefact would refute the spectral reading of the light analysis.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-EACHFAIL "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## The data held, counted

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-LYS">**Light profiles.** `lys.csv.gz` holds [2,370,091](../SOURCES.md#F-d9b22c989d) records at [566](../SOURCES.md#F-c9c0e8b759) stations with a position; this project's light analysis counts [62,741](../SOURCES.md#F-e98d356567) casts in it with a positive Kd and a date, [60,697](../SOURCES.md#F-7e31872a83) of them with a fit correlation of at least [0.9](../SOURCES.md#F-aba786ac0d) or none reported.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-LYS "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-LYSCOLS">Each record carries the depths its regression used, `ZMin` and `ZMax` — the instruction's *øverste* and *nederst dybde som er anvendt* — and its correlation coefficient: Kd is a regression the operator fitted over a window the operator chose, a profile collapsed to one slope.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-LYSCOLS "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-FIT">Require the fit coefficient: the instruction forbids reporting a Kd converted from Secchi depth as a Kd value (*må ikke indrapporteres til databasen som Kd-værdier*), and a fitted correlation shows a record came from a profile, so a record that broke the rule cannot enter.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-FIT "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-CTDPARAM">**CTD channels.** The CTD extract carries `Lysdæmpning` on [5,217,377](../SOURCES.md#F-3b0f7011a8) rows, `Fluorescens` on [6,783,790](../SOURCES.md#F-3a1131d7c3), `Turbiditet` on [1,076,915](../SOURCES.md#F-85266abfd1) and `FDOM` on [890,921](../SOURCES.md#F-acb2b229c0), with `Photometer måling` on [576,179](../SOURCES.md#F-9529de8510) and `Photometer reference` on [531,071](../SOURCES.md#F-570ef298c6) beside them.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-CTDPARAM "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-UNITS">The unit column, `Enhed`, says what they are, by count: `FTU` stands on [1,076,915](../SOURCES.md#F-4d9618c375) rows, exactly as many as `Turbiditet`; `ppb` on [890,921](../SOURCES.md#F-0063f575ec), as many as `FDOM`; `µmol fotoner/(m2*sek)` on [1,107,250](../SOURCES.md#F-926c3edd35), as many as the photometer channels together ([1,107,250](../SOURCES.md#F-9120afde84)); and `pct` on [11,815,696](../SOURCES.md#F-77356724ba), as many as `Lysdæmpning` and oxygen saturation (`Oxygenmætning`) together ([11,815,696](../SOURCES.md#F-cbbbb6cb01)). So turbidity and FDOM are in sensor units and the photometers in photon flux, and `Lysdæmpning` is a percentage — matching the instruction's light value in the water column as a percentage of surface irradiance (*lysværdi i vandsøjlen i procent af overfladeindstråling*), not its attenuation coefficient, whose unit is per metre.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-UNITS "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-REFIT">The photometer channels — a reading and a reference, in the photon-flux unit the instruction gives for surface light — look like the underwater and surface sensors its fit is made from, one value per depth row. If they are, Kd can be refitted over a *stated* window instead of the operator's, on the same cast as the composition channels. The reading channel has more rows than the reference, so not every reading has its reference.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-REFIT "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-FDOMSPAN">`FDOM` runs only from [2021](../SOURCES.md#F-281b3dc6e4) to [2026](../SOURCES.md#F-70522e245c), so a test on both composition channels is confined to those years; before them the extract holds no other channel for dissolved organic matter.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-FDOMSPAN "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-PROXY">Errors in the proxies: `ppb` and `FTU` are sensor units, not absorption coefficients; FDOM is fluorescence (fluorescent dissolved organic matter), not absorption by coloured dissolved organic matter; and turbidity is light scattered at right angles, not absorption by non-algal particles.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-PROXY "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-SONDE">`SondeNr` is the placeholder `999`, probe unknown, on [25.6](../SOURCES.md#F-18d47162ce)% of the CTD extract's rows, so on those rows the probe, and any calibration tied to it, cannot be identified.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-SONDE "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-NOCLOCK">Over all of it, the extract has no wavelength column and no time of day.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-NOCLOCK "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## Procedure

1. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-S1">Cast table from `lys.csv.gz` via `formats.num()`: station, date, Kd, fit, `ZMin`, `ZMax`; keep casts with a fit coefficient.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-S1 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
2. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-S2">Stream `ctd.csv.gz` once, cast-contiguous (flush on key change, count reopened keys), emitting per station and date the depth-median `Fluorescens`, `FDOM` and `Turbiditet` **over `ZMin…ZMax`** — the layer the Kd was fitted over, not the whole cast.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-S2 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
3. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-S3">Inner-join on station and date; report how the joined subset differs from all light casts in Kd, station and month — that selection is the first result.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-S3 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
4. <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-S4">Apportion Kd's variance among the proxies within station × month, then fit the ordering and the constant against `maaledybde.csv.gz` Secchi on the same station-day, and the artefact — each against the permutation null below, reported as a distribution rather than a p-value. Repeat with satellite absorption and backscatter retrievals where one reaches back before the FDOM record.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-S4 "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## The null, under the constraint imposed

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-NULL">Not a regression's nominal F-null. Casts are clustered by station, seasonal and autocorrelated, and the composition channels share a station's mean level with Kd. **Permute the composition channels together, one row per cast, across casts within station × calendar month**, preserving each channel's marginals and the station/season structure, and rebuild the apportionment [1,000](../SOURCES.md#F-a8c6a58fbf) times; the observed unique variance must beat that distribution. Same permutation for the constant and the artefact; the result is whatever the permutation returns, reported even when it exceeds the observed statistic.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-NULL "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-MATCH">The satellite arm's null is built on the matched subset: `matchup.py` records, from its first run, that casts with a same-day satellite retrieval are clearer than the rest in the same months, so the matched days are not a random sample of days.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-MATCH "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## The residual, named

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-SUM">`Kd = K_water + K_phyto + K_CDOM + K_NAP`. On the in-situ arm **none of the terms is in absorption units**, so this yields a variance apportionment, not a budget, and the residual holds the start-depth artefact, the operator's window choice and the time of day.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-SUM "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-SATSPLIT">The satellite arm cannot split dissolved matter from detritus: its absorption term for them (`adg`) is one combined coefficient.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-SATSPLIT "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-SHRINK">A residual is testable only by measuring a part out of it and checking that it shrinks by exactly that part — which needs absorption in units: a spectrophotometer or spectroradiometer profile beside the PAR cast.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-SHRINK "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-ACS">Such profiles have been taken in Danish waters: Gonçalves-Araujo and Markager (2020) mounted an AC-S spectrophotometer on the CTD frame at stations of the national monitoring programme (NOVANA) around Fyn, in autumn [2017](../SOURCES.md#F-d9ff81f6d8) and spring [2019](../SOURCES.md#F-9cd06b0ad3), and call the instrument's incorporation into the sampling programme in [2017](../SOURCES.md#F-f78ca07907) a first step toward automated, sensor-based monitoring.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-ACS "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-ACSGAP">None of the CTD extract's `Parameter` values is an absorption, so no such profile reaches the extract this project holds; until one does, the shrinkage test is joint with a spectral model.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-ACSGAP "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## What it licenses

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-WOULD">**Would:** a statement about the *record* — whether Kd's cast-to-cast variance at named stations in named months is carried mainly by the chlorophyll channel, against a permutation null, and whether the instruction's fixed constant of [2.3](../SOURCES.md#F-2914daeb4b) is composition-free.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-WOULD "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-WOULDNOT">**Would not:** a physical budget, a causal attribution, any per-water-body or national number, or any trend.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-WOULDNOT "What this claim rests on")</sup>

## Sources, and whether each is a separate production path

- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-SRC-CTD">**Held: the CTD extract's light and composition channels**, per depth. **Not a separate path** from the light profiles: the instruction says the light sensor is usually mounted on the CTD (*sædvanligvis monteret på CTD’en*).</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-SRC-CTD "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-SRC-131">**Copernicus Marine [`OCEANCOLOUR_BAL_BGC_L3_NRT_009_131`](https://data.marine.copernicus.eu/product/OCEANCOLOUR_BAL_BGC_L3_NRT_009_131/description)** — near-real-time daily observations from OLCI at [300](../SOURCES.md#F-65275c0814) m, with an optics dataset of absorption and backscatter by dissolved and particulate matter and by phytoplankton (`ADG`, `APH`, `BBP`) from the QAA model; its catalogue record starts in [2023](../SOURCES.md#F-42bd0b3e37).</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-SRC-131 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-SRC-208">**Copernicus Marine [`OCEANCOLOUR_BAL_BGC_HR_L4_NRT_009_208`](https://data.marine.copernicus.eu/product/OCEANCOLOUR_BAL_BGC_HR_L4_NRT_009_208/description)** — `Sentinel-2` MSI at [100](../SOURCES.md#F-3bf40e74c8) m for a [20](../SOURCES.md#F-3bf40e74c8) km coastal zone: turbidity, suspended matter, particulate backscatter (`BBP443`) and chlorophyll, and no absorption variable; its catalogue record starts in [2020](../SOURCES.md#F-86d84f5d45).</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-SRC-208 "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-SRC-CCI">**ESA Ocean Colour CCI inherent optical properties, `v6.0`** ([CEDA](https://catalogue.ceda.ac.uk/uuid/024292dcda5d42ceb326850f89f8b40d/)) — global, at approximately [4](../SOURCES.md#F-240370bce1) km, in composites from daily to yearly, covering [1997](../SOURCES.md#F-229649d509) to [2022](../SOURCES.md#F-229649d509): total absorption and backscatter, and absorption by detrital and dissolved matter and by phytoplankton, the dissolved-and-detrital term from the QAA model.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-SRC-CCI "What this claim rests on")</sup>
- <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-SRC-MODIS">**NASA Aqua MODIS `L3` inherent optical properties, version `2022.0`** ([Earthdata](https://www.earthdata.nasa.gov/data/catalog/ob-cloud-modisa-l3m-iop-2022.0)) — retrieved with the GIOP model framework, not QAA: phytoplankton absorption and combined CDOM and detritus absorption (`aph_443`, `adg_443`), from [2002](../SOURCES.md#F-27274090f2).</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-SRC-MODIS "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-SRC-PATH">Every satellite product above is a retrieval of optical properties from reflectance — a model applied to radiometry from orbit — so each is a separate production path from the ship's casts, and none is a measurement of absorption in the water.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-SRC-PATH "What this claim rests on")</sup>

<span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-SRC-133">The Baltic multiyear product already fetched, `OCEANCOLOUR_BAL_BGC_L3_MY_009_133`, names plankton, reflectances and transparency in its title and no optics, where its near-real-time sibling's title adds optics.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-SRC-133 "What this claim rests on")</sup> <span class="claim" data-claim="C-DZ-Z8-SEARCH">Beyond these, the source register records searches of PANGAEA and of that product for spectral absorption in Danish water, with a Roskilde Fjord series as the only positive: an absence over those searches, *not a finding that none exists*.</span><sup class="claim-mark">[†](../CLAIMS.md#C-DZ-Z8-SEARCH "What this claim rests on")</sup>
